lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: guide ordering for a guest, keep a professional conversation going, and settle the bill discreetly
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Take a local supplier to lunch, help them order, keep the conversation going, and pay without fuss.
lessons.title: Host a Supplier at Lunch
lessons.objective: Help a visiting supplier order, discuss the work over lunch, and pay discreetly.
lessons.focus: Use je vous invite, qu’est-ce qui vous ferait plaisir and je vais régler l’addition to guide a professional meal.
lessons.scene: Maya hosts a visiting supplier at a neighborhood restaurant.

cards.en: I am inviting you to lunch.

cards.fr: Je vous conseille le plat du jour.

cards.en: Let us talk about our project.

cards.fr: Je vais régler l’addition au comptoir.
cards.en: I will settle the bill at the counter.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bienvenue. Je vous invite à déjeuner.
reader.en: Welcome. I am inviting you to lunch.

reader.speaker: Supplier
reader.fr: Merci. Qu’est-ce que vous recommandez ?
reader.en: Thank you. What do you recommend?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le plat du jour est excellent. Qu’est-ce qui vous ferait plaisir ?
reader.en: The daily special is excellent. What would you like?

reader.speaker: Supplier
reader.fr: Je prendrai le plat du jour, merci.
reader.en: I will have the daily special, thank you.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Parlons de notre projet. Quel délai vous conviendrait ?
reader.en: Let us talk about our project. What timeline would suit you?

reader.speaker: Supplier
reader.fr: La semaine prochaine me conviendrait.
reader.en: Next week would suit me.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Très bien. Je vais régler l’addition au comptoir.
reader.en: Very good. I will settle the bill at the counter.

reader.speaker: Supplier
reader.fr: Merci pour ce déjeuner et cette conversation.
reader.en: Thank you for this lunch and this conversation.

speaking.opening: Bienvenue. Je vous invite à déjeuner.
speaking.goal: Welcome the supplier, help them choose, discuss the project timeline and settle the bill at the counter.
speaking.closure: Merci pour cette conversation. À bientôt.
wordBank: Je vous conseille le plat du jour.
Je vais régler l’addition au comptoir.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for supplier.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the recommendation of the daily special.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for bill.

say.cueEnglish: Ask what timeline would suit the guest.

write.cueEnglish: Write how you will settle the bill at the counter.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The supplier and project timeline are fictional. Review professional register and the naturalness of settling the bill at the counter.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Order lunch by phone for pickup
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: order clearly, spell a name, and confirm pickup time and total
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Phone a takeaway shop, order lunch for four, spell your name, and confirm the pickup time and total.
lessons.title: Phone in a Lunch Order for Four
lessons.objective: Order four takeaway lunches, spell the pickup name and confirm time and total.
lessons.focus: Use à emporter, épeler, à quelle heure and le total to confirm a telephone order.
lessons.scene: Maya phones a takeaway shop for four lunches to collect at twelve thirty.

cards.fr: Je voudrais commander pour quatre personnes.
cards.en: I would like to order for four people.

cards.fr: Deux sandwichs et deux salades, s’il vous plaît.
cards.en: Two sandwiches and two salads, please.

cards.fr: Je peux passer à midi et demi ?
cards.en: Can I come by at twelve thirty?

cards.fr: Le total est de trente-deux euros.

reader.speaker: Shop
reader.fr: Bonjour, service à emporter.
reader.en: Hello, takeaway service.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Je voudrais commander pour quatre personnes.
reader.en: Hello. I would like to order for four people.

reader.speaker: Shop
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Que voulez-vous ?
reader.en: Of course. What would you like?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Deux sandwichs au fromage et deux salades, s’il vous plaît.
reader.en: Two cheese sandwiches and two salads, please.

reader.speaker: Shop
reader.fr: À quel nom ? Pouvez-vous l’épeler ?
reader.en: Under what name? Can you spell it?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Martin : M-A-R-T-I-N. Je peux passer à midi et demi ?
reader.en: Martin: M-A-R-T-I-N. Can I come by at twelve thirty?

reader.speaker: Shop
reader.fr: Oui. Le total est de trente-deux euros.
reader.en: Yes. The total is thirty-two euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Trente-deux euros, à midi et demi. Je confirme la commande.
reader.en: Thirty-two euros, at twelve thirty. I confirm the order.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. Je voudrais commander pour quatre personnes.
speaking.goal: Order two cheese sandwiches and two salads, spell Martin and repeat the twelve-thirty pickup and thirty-two-euro total.
wordBank: Je voudrais commander pour quatre personnes.
Deux sandwichs et deux salades, s’il vous plaît.
Je peux passer à midi et demi ?
Le total est de trente-deux euros.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the order for four people.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the spelled pickup name.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for total.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether you can come at twelve thirty.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The shop, price and pickup time are fictional. Review phone register and pronunciation of spelled letters.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask to join a communal table, chat about the food, and respect others' space
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: At a crowded market hall, ask to join strangers at a shared table and chat about what they ordered.
lessons.title: Join a Communal Lunch Table
lessons.objective: Ask strangers for a seat, ask about their lunch and keep the shared space comfortable.
lessons.focus: Use cette place est libre, ça vous dérange si and qu’est-ce que vous avez pris to join a table politely.
lessons.scene: A crowded market hall has one open seat at a communal table.

cards.fr: Ça vous dérange si je m’assieds ici ?
cards.en: Do you mind if I sit here?

cards.fr: Je peux poser mon plateau ici ?
cards.en: May I put my tray here?

cards.fr: Je vais vous laisser de la place.
cards.en: I will leave you some space.
Thank you for sharing the table.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Cette place est libre ?
reader.en: Hello. Is this seat free?

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Oui, elle est libre.
reader.en: Yes, it is free.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ça vous dérange si je m’assieds ici ?
reader.en: Do you mind if I sit here?

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Pas du tout, installez-vous.
reader.en: Not at all, have a seat.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Je peux poser mon plateau ici ?
reader.en: Thank you. May I put my tray here?

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Bien sûr.
reader.en: Of course.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Qu’est-ce que vous avez pris ? Cette soupe a l’air bonne.
reader.en: What did you order? That soup looks good.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: C’est la spécialité du marché. Elle me plaît beaucoup.
reader.en: It is the market specialty. I like it a lot.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je vais vous laisser de la place. Merci de partager la table.
reader.en: I will leave you some space. Thank you for sharing the table.

speaking.goal: Ask for the seat and tray space, chat about the soup, then make room and thank the other guest.
wordBank: Ça vous dérange si je m’assieds ici ?
Je peux poser mon plateau ici ?
Je vais vous laisser de la place.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French phrase for an open seat.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the question asking to sit down.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about the other guest’s order.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for tray.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the guest likes the soup.

write.cueEnglish: Write a polite promise to leave some space.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The market specialty is fictional. Review natural market-hall register and varied polite responses.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: explain that you must go, pay for what you had, and part without a scene
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: After 40 minutes without your main course, explain you must leave, pay for your drinks, and part courteously.
lessons.title: Leave Lunch After a Forty-Minute Wait
lessons.objective: Explain that the main course has not arrived after forty minutes, pay for drinks and leave courteously.
lessons.focus: Use j’attends depuis, je dois partir and je vais régler mes boissons to give a clear timeline and close the bill.
lessons.scene: Maya must leave the café after a forty-minute wait for her main course.

cards.en: I have been waiting for forty minutes.

cards.fr: Mon plat principal n’est pas arrivé.
cards.en: My main course has not arrived.

cards.fr: Je dois partir pour une réunion.
cards.en: I have to leave for a meeting.
I will pay for my drinks.
Can you cancel the main course?
How much do I owe for the drinks?

cards.fr: Merci de votre aide. Au revoir.
cards.en: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. J’attends depuis quarante minutes.
reader.en: Excuse me. I have been waiting for forty minutes.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je suis désolé. Votre plat principal arrive bientôt.
reader.en: I am sorry. Your main course will arrive soon.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci, mais je dois partir pour une réunion. Mon plat n’est pas arrivé.
reader.en: Thank you, but I have to leave for a meeting. My food has not arrived.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je comprends. Voulez-vous que j’annule le plat ?
reader.en: I understand. Would you like me to cancel the main course?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, s’il vous plaît. Je vais régler mes boissons.
reader.en: Yes, please. I will pay for my drinks.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Les boissons coûtent six euros.
reader.en: Of course. The drinks cost six euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Voici six euros. Merci de votre aide.
reader.en: Here are six euros. Thank you for your help.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Merci. Au revoir.
reader.en: Thank you. Goodbye.

speaking.goal: Explain the forty-minute wait and meeting, ask to cancel the unserved main course, pay six euros for drinks and leave courteously.
speaking.closure: Merci de votre aide. Au revoir.
wordBank: Mon plat principal n’est pas arrivé.
Je dois partir pour une réunion.
Merci de votre aide. Au revoir.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for main course.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to state the forty-minute wait.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the request to cancel the main course.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French verb for to leave.

say.cueEnglish: Say that you have to leave for a meeting.

write.cueEnglish: Write a question asking what you owe for drinks.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The server agrees to cancel the unserved course in this fictional scene; it is not a statement of a universal billing rule.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: complete a casual lunch with a special need, a declined upsell, a charge dispute, a local custom, and an extended conversation without English
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Host a long lunch for a mixed group—one child, one severe allergy, a contested charge—from finding a table to a memorable farewell.
lessons.title: Complete an Extended Group Lunch
lessons.objective: Host a full lunch for a child and a guest with a severe peanut allergy, decline an upsell, discuss a local custom, dispute a charge and say farewell in French.
lessons.focus: Reuse the direct peanut-allergy and kitchen-check questions with table, price, bill and after-meal conversation language in one extended exchange.
lessons.scene: Maya hosts a group of five, including a child, at a neighborhood lunch café; her friend has a severe peanut allergy.

cards.fr: Nous sommes cinq, avec un enfant.
cards.en: There are five of us, with a child.

cards.fr: Mon amie a une allergie grave aux cacahuètes.
cards.en: My friend has a severe peanut allergy.

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous vérifier les ingrédients avec la cuisine ?
cards.en: Can you check the ingredients with the kitchen?
Do you have a child’s chair?

cards.fr: Non merci, seulement le menu du jour.
cards.en: No thank you, just the lunch special.

cards.fr: Pourquoi restez-vous à table après le repas ?
cards.en: Why do you stay at the table after the meal?

cards.fr: Ce supplément figure sur l’addition par erreur.
cards.en: This extra charge is on the bill by mistake.

cards.fr: Merci pour ce déjeuner. À bientôt.
cards.en: Thank you for this lunch. See you soon.

cards.fr: Ce plat contient-il des cacahuètes, ou est-il préparé près de cacahuètes ?
cards.en: Does this dish contain peanuts, or is it prepared near peanuts?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Nous sommes cinq, avec un enfant. Avez-vous une chaise pour enfant ?
reader.en: Hello. There are five of us, with a child. Do you have a child’s chair?

reader.speaker: Serveur
reader.fr: Bonjour. Oui, la voici. Cette table vous convient ?
reader.en: Hello. Yes, here it is. Does this table suit you?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, merci. Mon amie a une allergie grave aux cacahuètes. Pouvez-vous vérifier les ingrédients avec la cuisine ?
reader.en: Yes, thank you. My friend has a severe peanut allergy. Can you check the ingredients with the kitchen?

reader.speaker: Serveur
reader.fr: Je vérifie avec la cuisine.
reader.en: I will check with the kitchen.

reader.speaker: Serveur
reader.fr: La cuisine confirme que le menu du jour ne contient pas de cacahuètes.
reader.en: The kitchen confirms that the lunch special does not contain peanuts.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Nous prenons le menu du jour pour tous.
reader.en: Thank you. We will all have the lunch special.

reader.speaker: Serveur
reader.fr: Souhaitez-vous ajouter un vin plus cher ?
reader.en: Would you like to add a more expensive wine?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Non merci, seulement le menu du jour.
reader.en: No thank you, just the lunch special.

reader.speaker: Ami
reader.fr: On reste à table pour discuter après le repas ?
reader.en: Shall we stay at the table to talk after the meal?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Nous pouvons parler du voyage, de la famille et de demain.
reader.en: Yes. We can talk about the trip, family, and tomorrow.

reader.speaker: Ami
reader.fr: Pourquoi restez-vous à table après le repas ?
reader.en: Why do you stay at the table after the meal?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pour prolonger la conversation, dans mon cas.
reader.en: To continue the conversation, in my case.

reader.speaker: Ami
reader.fr: J’aime cette idée. Et comment avez-vous découvert ce café ?
reader.en: I like that idea. And how did you discover this café?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Un ami me l’a recommandé l’an dernier.
reader.en: A friend recommended it to me last year.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Voici l’addition. Ce supplément y figure par erreur.
reader.en: Here is the bill. This extra charge is on it by mistake.

reader.speaker: Serveur
reader.fr: Vous avez raison. Je le retire.
reader.en: You are right. I will remove it.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci pour ce déjeuner. À bientôt.
reader.en: Thank you for this lunch. See you soon.

Qualified French and food-allergy review remains required; the fictional kitchen statement is a scene utterance, not a reviewed factual guarantee.

internalReviewNotes: Core 26–30 map exact Spanish Lunch Core learning purposes to original French scenes. Qualified French and relevant domain review remain required.
